put.summary: Changes a version's status. Leaving draft runs the kind's publication rules; publishing stamps the publication time.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the version.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: A `version_kind` value, such as `dimension_version`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The version's surrogate key.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The transition applied; the body is the version's new state.

400.description: The kind or the target status is not a known value.

422.description: Publication rules rejected the version and its status is unchanged; `violations` lists why.
